Perform (specific)

Training Time (TT): 8 – 52 weeks

You can impress audiences with your talent and skill. Like Handicraft and Lore, Perform is actually comprised of several sub-skills. The various sub-skills are: Dance (DEX), Musicianship (drum, harp, flute, etc.) (DEX), Juggling (DEX), Acting (acting, mime, etc.) (CHA), Oratory (CHA), and Singing (CHA).
